silhouette.reason: Five necks rise and separate above the shoulders with spiked crests and differently horned heads; the sprawling body and long tail read as a hydra in every view.
fixes: larger dorsal spines along the back so the spine line reads in SIDE

proportions.reason: Legs are thicker and under the body; the trunk is a near-rectangular box in TOP and FRONT, with flat sides between the legs.
fixes: round the torso plan into a barrel tapering into the tail and the neck root

materials.reason: Olive skin with darker dorsal saddles, pale horns and claws, a lighter belly; skin, horn and claw share one roughness and the scales are colour only.
fixes: scale normal on the back and necks
separate keratin roughness for horns and claws

detail.reason: Crest spikes along every neck, open mouths with teeth, horns, claws and belly scutes hold at third person.
fixes: tongues and gums in the open mouths

wear.reason: One pink scar patch on the flank; no chipped horns, mud or cauterised stump.
fixes: mud on the feet and lower belly
a chipped horn and a scarred neck

lod.reason: FAR LOD2 keeps all five necks, horns and the outline; heads simplify without popping.
fixes: keep the dorsal saddle colour bands at LOD2

technical.reason: 210k LOD0 triangles is still about double a hero creature budget, though down from 348k; 2 draws.
fixes: cut neck and tail ring counts so LOD0 lands near 120k
spend the saved triangles on the heads
